props:
Generate a production transparent PROP ATLAS matching the attached approved north-up garden / ruins / red foundry art direction. Rich hand-painted fantasy action-game assets, detailed weathered materials, softly bevelled dimensional shapes, warm lamp highlights, deep contact shading. Four isolated objects in a strict equal 2 by 2 grid. Every asset fits entirely inside its quadrant with at least 25 pixels transparent margin on all sides, no part crosses the middle row or column. Transparent background, no grid, no lettering, no scene.
ALL objects: camera looking DOWN from the SOUTH at 50 degrees, ZERO yaw / north-up, front facade faces straight toward viewer, horizontal wall/stone courses are horizontal on the image. Visible tops and front faces, no diagonal isometric rotation. Root/base anchor bottom-center. Orthographic camera.
TOP LEFT: a substantial tall square ancient pale sage limestone pillar, four or five large weathered blocks, moss and leafy ivy hanging on its sides, bevelled plinth, a decorative bronze bowl torch at its top with a small vivid amber flame. Strong stone volume, about twice as tall as wide, tiny ferns rooted beside the base.
TOP RIGHT: a compact ruined stone wall monument, two thick mossy pillars around an arched dark SEALED niche, niche has a solid carved stone backing and cannot be walked through, fragmented top stones, leafy vines cascading down, a tiny cyan crystal in the niche. Broad rectangular solid base, no walk-through arch, approximately square overall image.
BOTTOM LEFT: a richly detailed red/burgundy clockwork power unit or large cover crate, box-shaped on a broad square metal foundation, chamfered corners, bronze rivets, recessed dark purple X braces, layered red frame, black mechanical vents, inset cyan lamps, a detailed top with raised mechanical coil and a small pressure gauge. No labels or numbers, no smoke.
BOTTOM RIGHT: a tall red industrial corner pillar on a square metal base, burgundy layered steel plates, copper rivets, violet reinforcement braces, an inset narrow amber lamp and a little cyan status light, bevelled red cap, visibly detailed front and top. Approximately twice as tall as wide.
Do not put grass under industrial assets. No characters, no background, no ground square, no detached parts, no floating objects. Consistent scale/material rendering with the approved mockup. This atlas supplies the actual game, prioritize clean complete isolated silhouettes and beautiful small-scale legibility.
materials:
Create a production texture atlas derived from the attached approved north-up fantasy game mockup. Match its lush hand-painted 3D game materials exactly. THIS IS A FLAT MATERIAL SHEET, not a scene or mockup.
One perfectly square image divided into an EXACT 3 by 3 grid of NINE equal square texture cells, edge to edge, no gaps, no borders, no labels, no objects crossing cells. Each individual cell must be an orthographic flat face-on, seamless repeatable material texture with even baked ambient shading, no perspective, no scene lighting cast shadows.
Cell order left to right, top to bottom:
1 rich emerald grass lawn with fine painterly blades and subtle moss clumps, no stones or large objects.
2 olive grey natural rocky cliff, irregular broad angular rocks, little moss in crevices, deep root seams, vertical face-on texture.
3 lush dense lime-green overlapping tiny hedge leaves with olive-green undergrowth shadows, rounded organic leaf layering filling entire cell.
4 worn sage grey squared flagstones, irregular softened joints, fine cracks and sparse moss, moderate scale like the garden stairs/paving in the approved image.
5 deep red/burgundy industrial wall plates, rivets, recessed dark violet cross-braces and vents, chunky red frames, straight orthogonal orientation, like panel C walls.
6 dark navy teal-grey industrial floor panels with fine engraved geometric/spiral motifs, subtle bevels, restrained highlights, like panel C flooring.
7 weathered pale sage limestone block masonry, moss growing in joints, face-on.
8 tarnished bronze/gold industrial trim with diagonal dark hazard stripes and rows of small rivets; entire square fills with repeating trim material.
9 blue grey worn engraved temple stone, intricate restrained carved spirals and interlocking panels.
Broad readable shapes, rich material variation and bevel shading, painterly fantasy action-game finish. No white highlights overpowering the surface, no text, no icons, no terrain outlines, no perspective. The nine cells must stay in exactly these slots.
foliage:
Derive a game-ready transparent foliage sprite atlas from the attached APPROVED north-up fantasy game art mockup. Match its painted leaf detail, rich greens, edge shapes and soft lighting.
One square transparent PNG containing EXACTLY FOUR isolated assets in a strict equal 2x2 cell layout. Each object centered in its own quadrant with generous transparent margin. No grid lines, no labels, no background, no ground rectangle, no drop shadow extending into neighboring cells.
TOP LEFT: a wide dense rounded hedge bush, bright lime-green leaves layered over deep emerald undergrowth, leaves individually legible, visible low twisting dark roots under the bush. Wider than tall; footprint represents a square hedge block, organic rounded silhouette, no flat cut sides.
TOP RIGHT: a graceful clump of ferns and broad curling jungle leaves with a few wispy grasses, lush green and teal highlights. Lower than the hedge.
BOTTOM LEFT: a small cluster of blue and white wildflowers, green leaves and fine grass around the stems; delicate blue petals with warm cream centers.
BOTTOM RIGHT: an irregular tuft of lush narrow bright emerald grass blades with some olive blades and several tiny clover leaves, natural fan shape.
Camera for ALL four: elevated north-up game camera, looking down at approximately 50 degrees from the horizon, ZERO isometric yaw; objects stand upright, feet/root anchor at bottom-center of their quadrant. Painterly stylized fantasy 3D game sprites consistent with the attached image. Real transparency. No rocks, no UI, no people, no text.
